title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
notes: claim 72: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing leaves SharePoint storage quota applicability unresolved even though its cited Loop policy covers Loop files in SharePoint Embedded. Its open question also incorrectly says the roadmap states Android note-taking is generally available; the record still says In development.

claims.claim: The Loop policy page says storage for Loop files counts against the organisation's SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Loop components and their integrations are powered by .loop files (earlier releases created .fluid files), stored in OneDrive, SharePoint, or SharePoint Embedded. Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.

claims.claim: Whether that SharePoint quota rule applies to the room notes' Loop files in SharePoint Embedded still needs confirmation.
claims.quote: Loop components and their integrations are powered by .loop files (earlier releases created .fluid files), stored in OneDrive, SharePoint, or SharePoint Embedded. Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence of Indirect costs with: "Learn describes room notes as Loop files in SharePoint Embedded; the Loop admin policy page says storage for Loop files, including those in SharePoint Embedded, counts against the organisation's SharePoint quota." Keep the existing citations to https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/loop-admin-configuration.

claims.claim: The room button is controlled in Pro Management portal at Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API or automation for the Pro Management portal Take notes setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator Show Take notes PowerShell API missing prerequisites. Opened Rooms Facilitator setup and read returned release-note and Facilitator-control excerpts; no API or PowerShell equivalent for the room button found.

claims.claim: General meeting transcription is configured in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the named meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The SharePoint organisation properties controlling Loop components and collaborative meeting notes in Teams have no documented admin UI equivalent.
claims.quote: Searched: Loop IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center UI SharePoint PowerShell. Opened Loop admin policies: Teams controls use SharePoint PowerShell; the documented Microsoft 365 admin UI controls Loop workspaces instead.

claims.claim: The Facilitator app is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Saved notes can be found through the meeting chat's Recap tab.
claims.quote: At the top of the meeting chat, select the Recap tab, and then select Notes to find the AI-generated notes and transcript.
